title: digital kitchen scale
text:
digital kitchen scale. very thin, easy to use. It's not a "fancy" scale, but I find when I want to quickly check my portion size or measurement, it's quick and easy. It doesn't have an "off" switch, but it turns itself off fairly quickly - it is, of course, battery powered. It is glass topped so it's easy to wipe clean. I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful. Also, happy to respond to any questions or comments!
UPDATE: 6/12/2017... I have been using the scale for several months. Still happy with use. Have check accuracy and it is good. Still a 5 star experience. Will continue to update as deemed useful.
